registry.toolXmlDesc: Format, minify, convert to JSON, run XPath queries, check well-formedness and structure

xml.xpathNote: XPath is a subset: /a/b, //b, {'@'}attr, [n], [{'@'}attr='v'], [child='v'], * are supported; functions, axes and | are not. [n] picks the nth item of the result list (standard XPath means the nth child of each parent).
xml.err_unclosedTag: Line {line}, column {column}: tag is not closed.
xml.err_unclosedElement: Line {line}, column {column}: element <{name}> is not closed.
xml.err_mismatchedTag: Line {line}, column {column}: mismatched tags — expected </{expected}>, found </{actual}>.
xml.err_multipleRoots: Line {line}, column {column}: XML allows only one root element (found {names}).
xml.err_attributeWithoutValue: Line {line}, column {column}: attribute {name} has no value (XML requires one).
xml.err_attributeNotQuoted: Line {line}, column {column}: the value of attribute {name} must be quoted.
xml.err_unclosedAttribute: Line {line}, column {column}: the quote of attribute {name} is not closed.
xml.err_ltInAttribute: Line {line}, column {column}: unescaped < in the value of attribute {name} (use <).
xml.err_unclosedComment: Line {line}, column {column}: comment is not closed (missing -->).
xml.err_unclosedCdata: Line {line}, column {column}: CDATA is not closed (missing ]]>).
xml.err_unclosedPi: Line {line}, column {column}: processing instruction is not closed (missing ?>).
xml.err_unclosedDoctype: Line {line}, column {column}: DOCTYPE is not closed.
